name: Employee Details Incorrect Flow
goal: User indicates employee details are incorrect and exits to main menu.
constraints: User selects 'No' at employee details confirmation and then 'Go Back to Main Menu'.

phases.description: User is presented with the VPF intro and chooses 'PROCEED'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays intro message and user selects 'PROCEED'.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details for confirmation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and user selects 'No'.

phases.description: Bot presents 'Go Back to Main Menu' option; user selects it.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot resets variables and goes to exit, asking if anything else is needed.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
